title: Write a response check
summary: A Postman response script can assert facts about the last response. pm is provided by Postman's script environment.
introduction: A Postman response script can assert facts about the last response. pm is provided by Postman's script environment. We will use a small example so you can follow each step.
learningObjectives: Use the example to answer a practice question

blocks.text: A Postman response script can assert facts about the last response. pm is provided by Postman's script environment.
This check passes only if the actual response status is 200. It belongs in Postman, not this site's JavaScript runner.

items: Read the example from top to bottom. Point to the part that uses the new idea.
Write a separate check for the expected Content-Type header.
Explain what changed in your own words. Check the example again if you get stuck.

blocks.title: A common mistake
blocks.text: A status check alone does not verify every field in a response body.
For more detail later, use this [Postman further reading](https://learning.postman.com/docs/getting-started/overview/).
